req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-025 requires that all /tasks/* endpoints returning a body respond with Content-Type: application/json. We must verify: (1) POST /tasks/ returns 201 with application/json (positive/EP), (2) GET /tasks/ returns 200 with application/json (positive/EP), (3) GET /tasks/{id} for existing task returns 200 with application/json (positive/EP), (4) PUT /tasks/{id} returns 200 with application/json (positive/EP), (5) GET /tasks/{id} for non-existent task returns 404 with application/json error body (negative/NEG — error paths must also be JSON), (6) DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 with NO body — boundary case since 204 has no body so content-type assertion is not applicable (BVA). We also check the exact content-type string value to catch constant-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_post_tasks_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid JSON body {title: 'Test Task', description: 'desc', completed: false}
Inspect response status code and Content-Type header
expected: Response body is valid JSON with field 'id', 'title', 'completed'
trace: R-TASK-025: POST /tasks/ endpoint returning body must have application/json Content-Type
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_post_tasks_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Test Task", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Test Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body

test_post_tasks_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_get_tasks_with_completed_filter_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
Tasks with completed=True and completed=False are created
actions: POST two tasks: one completed=True, one completed=False
GET /tasks/?completed=true
Inspect response status code, Content-Type header, and body contents
expected: Response body is a JSON array containing only completed tasks
trace: R-TASK-025: GET /tasks/ with query filter must still return application/json Content-Type
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_get_tasks_with_completed_filter_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Done Task", "completed": True})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Pending Task", "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    r = client.get("/tasks/?completed=true")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert all(t["completed"] == True for t in body)

test_get_tasks_with_completed_filter_returns_json_content_type()
